entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Used assembly analysis does not take into account anonymous types #78759
  • VS 2022 Preview Roslyn crashes when using a non-existent attribute after if followed by else on a new line #78749

Closed

  • Extension everything public metadata types break .NET package validation #78416
    Next
  • Extensions: Extension method prevents extension property of the same name from being accessed #78753
    Next
  • Single-file run with VSCode has rough integration points #78752
  • Refactoring to generate ArgumentOutOfRange checks on numeric types #37653
    Backlog
  • How to create source generator that uses types from a referenced assembly? #78699
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-10628.69 #78743

PullRequests

Created

  • Extensions: relax inferrability rule for methods #78758
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Fix crash when determining if on header of invalid if-statement #78757
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Update progression work to have context menu. #78754
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Disable TransitiveVersioningPinning for RoslynAnalyzers. #78747
  • Do not set NGenArchitecture to 'All' and let it take defaults. #78746
  • Partial updates #78744
    Area-Interactive, VSCode

Merged

  • Break code for handling a request to FindRefs/GoToBase/GoToImpl out of the editor command handlers for those features. #78751
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Revert "[release/dev17.14] Use a project reference for M.CA.AnalyzerUtilities" #78736
  • Add operator == and != for DocumentUri #78756
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Unify command handler code for 'go to base/impl' and 'find refs' #78750
    Area-IDE, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #78745
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Add numeric parameter checks refactoring #78748
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Add Copilot Change Analysis to External Access #78739
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Add direct IVTs to internal projects #78742
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Merge main to runtime async branch #78740
    Needs API Review, VSCode

Updated

  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers
  • Move Semantic tests to NetLatest #78453
    Area-Compilers, untriaged
  • Improve applicability to receiver type check for extension binary operators #78728
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Sem update #78467
    Area-IDE, untriaged, VSCode
  • Move off of Progression for solution explorer. #78714

  • Recommend `#define`d preprocessing symbols within a file #78451

  • Initial support for conditional logical binary extension operators #78706
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything

  • Extensions: ignore static/instance mismatches for properties inside nameof #78725
